audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Pantheon's PASSIVE blocks basic attacks from the front. His passive is Mortal Will ('Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered'). The front-block is Aegis Assault (E).
audit.why: Aegis Assault: 400 range, 22/21/20/19/18s, 'sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly' — and it is a channel, so it is interruptible. Shield Vault (W) is the 600-range point-click stun dash on 13/12/11/10/9s with an auto-attack reset.
audit.corrected: Front-block = Aegis Assault (E), 22s at rank 1, interruptible channel; Mortal Will only empowers his next spell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill for Level 6 and First item. The packet chart over 1386 games gives both to Mordekaiser.
audit.why: The page's own prose says so too: whys[4] 'Realm of Death isolates him... his early lead and W stun mean nothing', whys[5] 'makes the E-pull-into-Q all-in lethal exactly as his point-and-click damage plateaus'.
audit.corrected: Rows 4 and 5 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group -> Mordekaiser, with ratings 7/10 and 7/10. Rows 0-3 and 6 already match the packet.

audit.why: Spike structure is right: his is levels 1-3 (Shield Vault + an empowered Comet Spear), yours are level 6 and first item, and he falls off into items. Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s at 5500 range, so it is a map tool rather than a lane spike.
audit.corrected: Left as written, with the level-6 and first-item rows now credited to you in the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Only one sequencing cue on the page and no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: The three timers that matter: Shield Vault 13s, Aegis Assault 22s, and your own Death's Grasp 16/14/12/10/8s — at rank 1 the longest basic cooldown in the matchup, so a missed pull is sixteen free seconds for him.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and the don'ts.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — His all-in start. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Pantheon Shield Vault: Leaps to a target, stuns, and strikes — his all-in start. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (W): matchup-defining — a 600-range point-click stun dash on 13s at rank 1. Bait it, then commit. - Pantheon Aegis Assault (E): 22s channel, invulnerable from the front — go around it or wait it out.

edits.before: His all-in start. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1. Commit only once it is spent.

edits.before: That is Pantheon's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Shield Vault is point-click — there is no dodging it, so trade only after it goes.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Aegis Assault blocks front damage on a 22s cooldown — hit it from behind.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Death's Grasp is 16s at rank 1 — a missed pull is sixteen free seconds for a Pantheon whose whole plan is owning the first three levels.

edits.before: Darkness Rise rewards the long fight, but his Q spear chip and front-block passive keep him even at range — neither side lands a clean kill if both play tight.
edits.after: Darkness Rise rewards the long fight, but Comet Spear chip and Aegis Assault's front-block keep him even — neither side lands a clean kill if both play tight.

edits.before: "His level 1-3 is the scary part — Pantheon's W is a point-click stun, so the moment you step up he can lock you and dump an empowered Q spear before your passive even has 3 stacks for Darkness Rise. Don't trade into that: eat minimal poke, last-hit with Obliterate's cone, and bank an Indestructible shield. His passive blocks the next basic attack from the front, so don't feed autos into it — let your Q do the work. Good news: he has no sustain, so any chip he eats trading he can't get back, and once your aura is online he can't out-grind you."
edits.after: "His level 1-3 is the scary part — Shield Vault is a point-click stun on 13s, so the moment you step up he can lock you and dump an empowered Comet Spear before your passive even has 3 stacks for Darkness Rise. Don't trade into that: eat minimal poke, last-hit with Obliterate's cone, and bank an Indestructible shield. Aegis Assault makes him invulnerable from the front while it channels, so don't feed autos into it — let your Q do the work. Good news: he has no sustain, so any chip he eats he can't get back."

edits.before: Use his passive to block your front-facing autos and chip you down with Q spear from range
edits.after: Use Aegis Assault to block your front-facing autos and chip you with Comet Spear from range

notes: Mirror (pantheon side) reported this as an unusually clean page and it mostly is — the one factual error is the passive: the front-block belongs to Aegis Assault (E, 22s at rank 1, an interruptible channel), while Mortal Will only empowers his next spell. Chart needed two rows (Level 6, First item) flipped to Mordekaiser to match the 1386-game packet and the page's own whys; proposed as an atomic pair set. dontsFull[1].t reads 'Sit low for his W execute' — there is NO execute anywhere in Pantheon's current kit; the title is 25 characters so an edit may fall under the applier's short-string skip, and I left it rather than risk an unmatched change. Flagged for the user below. Not asserted (kits do not cover it): whether Realm of Death can be cast on a Pantheon channelling Aegis Assault, and whether Obliterate can interrupt that channel.
